purpose: Full documentary and commercial re-evaluation of all currently listed projects; not a source-code audit, independent appraisal or execution campaign.
valuationDecision: No current asset-level or aggregate monetary valuation is established from the reviewed documentation. Not established does not mean zero. Previous seller asks are historical negotiating references, not newly endorsed valuations.

findings: All 79 previous market and income proxies and strategic calculations reproduce from the same replacement-cost anchor and generic factors.
The model provides multiple scenarios of one cost assumption, not four independent observations of value.
The reviewed materials do not establish component-level replacement estimates with rates, effort and obsolescence adjustments.
No asset-specific comparable-rights transactions or reliable buyer cash-flow model are established in the reviewed material.
Generic technical and commercial probabilities were assigned by broad labels; no asset-specific calibration supports their use as measured probabilities.
A common weighting does not resolve missing evidence or the correlation between calculations.
Portfolio addition requires separate rights, overlapping work and buyer synergy review; a sum of standalone references is not a portfolio sale value.

methodRequirements.needed: Defined equivalent utility, reusable work scope, effort by role, appropriate rates, third-party exclusions, obsolescence and overlap adjustments.
Transactions or licences for comparable rights, with maturity, scale, date, geography and economic terms reconciled.
Defensible asset-attributable revenue or royalties, margins, operating and completion costs, useful life and discount-rate assumptions.
Identified buyer, incremental benefits, integration costs, execution risks and evidence supporting synergy assumptions.
